review.summary: Re-solved all 25; answers and en/id parity are clean. No correctness defects. Verified by hand: Q2 (27), Q6 (Sat+4=Wed), Q7 (day 7 = 192cm), Q13 (closest sum to 500 is uniquely 555 → digit sum 15), Q16 (145≤150 → 15), Q17 (D=2B → 2), Q19 (666+668+688=2022 → 22), Q20 (dial walk on rim 0/3/1/9/2/7/6/4/8/5 → 95328), Q22 (combos {(1,4,1),(2,2,2),(3,0,3)} forced). Figure-dependent answers checked for internal consistency. NOTE: this paper's hint_steps are markedly thinner than 2019–2021 (often assert the figure-read answer instead of deriving it) — it appears mid-enrichment in the working tree.

findings.note: Representative of a paper-wide pattern: the hint asserts the best T-placement (43+28+20+57=148) without enumerating the placements. Several figure-dependent questions are similarly thin — Q1 ('compare, count → B'), Q3, Q5, Q8 ('Option C has the greatest total length'), Q11 ('Celine highest, Bob lowest'), Q21, Q23, Q24 — they state the answer rather than derive it. Answers are right but the hint_steps are below the depth set by the 2019–2021 papers; enrich before approving.

The three equal-weight combos {(1,4,1),(2,2,2),(3,0,3)} are uniquely forced (verified), but WHICH belongs to Carter (→ 4 red) is not deducible from the stem — it relies on figure info. Fine if the figure pins one person; worth confirming the stem/figure makes Carter's row determinate.

questions.body_en: The shark can eat any fish whose number is smaller than 374. How many fish can it eat?

321, 286, and 357 are smaller than 374.
There are 3 edible fish, so choose B.
hint_steps_id: Bandingkan setiap bilangan ikan dengan 374.
321, 286, dan 357 lebih kecil dari 374.
Ada 3 ikan yang dapat dimakan, jadi pilih B.

highlights.note_en: Only numbers below 374 count.
highlights.note_id: Hanya bilangan di bawah 374 yang dihitung.

questions.body_en: Burt buys 7 chocolates and Lance buys 5. They share all 12 chocolates equally with Sara. How many chocolates should Burt give Sara?
questions.body_id: Burt membeli 7 cokelat dan Lance membeli 5. Mereka membagi semua 12 cokelat sama rata bersama Sara. Berapa cokelat yang harus Burt berikan kepada Sara?
hint_steps_en: There are 7 + 5 = 12 chocolates.
Three people receive 12 ÷ 3 = 4 each.
Burt has 7, so he gives Sara 7 − 4 = 3 chocolates: B.
hint_steps_id: Jumlah cokelat 7 + 5 = 12.
Tiga orang masing-masing menerima 12 ÷ 3 = 4.
Burt punya 7, jadi ia memberi Sara 7 − 4 = 3 cokelat: B.

highlights.note_en: Add their chocolates first.
highlights.note_id: Jumlahkan cokelat mereka dahulu.

highlights.note_en: Each of three people must finish with four.
highlights.note_id: Masing-masing dari tiga orang harus mendapat empat.

strategy.name_en: Find the equal share, then Burt's excess
strategy.name_id: Cari bagian sama rata, lalu kelebihan Burt

questions.body_en: Kiki has six balls. There are as many black balls as white balls, and more large balls than small balls. Which option might show her balls?
questions.body_id: Kiki memiliki enam bola. Banyak bola hitam sama dengan bola putih, dan bola besar lebih banyak daripada bola kecil. Pilihan mana yang mungkin menunjukkan bolanya?

Then check size: large balls must outnumber small balls.
Only option B has 3 black, 3 white, 4 large, and 2 small balls.
hint_steps_id: Periksa warna dahulu: pilihan harus memiliki 3 bola hitam dan 3 bola putih.
Lalu periksa ukuran: bola besar harus lebih banyak daripada bola kecil.
Hanya pilihan B yang memiliki 3 hitam, 3 putih, 4 besar, dan 2 kecil.

questions.body_en: Tomorrow is Saturday and Mom's birthday. Dad's birthday is 60 days after Mom's birthday. What day is Dad's birthday?

hint_steps_en: Mom's birthday is Saturday.
60 days = 56 days + 4 days, and 56 days is exactly 8 weeks.
Four days after Saturday is Wednesday, so choose C.
hint_steps_id: Ulang tahun Ibu hari Sabtu.
60 hari = 56 hari + 4 hari, dan 56 hari tepat 8 minggu.
Empat hari setelah Sabtu adalah Rabu, jadi pilih C.

Ann > Ken > Pan. Among the remaining pictured heights, Pan is shortest, then Ken, then Ann.
Left to right: Dan, Pan, Ken, Ann, so choose C.
hint_steps_id: Dan paling tinggi, jadi anak paling kiri yang diberi bintang adalah Dan.
Ann > Ken > Pan. Dari tinggi gambar yang tersisa, Pan paling pendek, lalu Ken, lalu Ann.

Celine has the highest total and Bob the lowest, so choose D.

questions.body_en: Use the cards 9, 6, 4, 0, 2, and 3 exactly once to form two 3-digit numbers whose sum is closest to 500. Find the sum of the digits of that total.
questions.body_id: Gunakan kartu 9, 6, 4, 0, 2, dan 3 tepat sekali untuk membentuk dua bilangan 3 angka yang jumlahnya paling dekat dengan 500. Tentukan jumlah digit dari hasil tersebut.
hint_steps_en: Arrange the hundreds digits so the total is near 500, then balance tens and ones.
Check the closest candidate totals using every card exactly once.
The closest total has digit sum 15, so choose C.
hint_steps_id: Atur digit ratusan agar jumlah mendekati 500, lalu seimbangkan puluhan dan satuan.
Periksa calon jumlah terdekat dengan memakai setiap kartu tepat sekali.
Jumlah terdekat memiliki jumlah digit 15, jadi pilih C.

highlights.note_en: All six cards must be used with no repeats.
highlights.note_id: Semua enam kartu harus digunakan tanpa pengulangan.

highlights.note_en: Minimise the distance from 500 before adding result digits.

questions.body_en: There are 150 dinosaur eggs. 48 are carnivorous eggs and the rest are herbivorous. If 17 carnivorous eggs hatch and five times as many herbivorous eggs hatch, how many herbivorous eggs remain unhatched?
questions.body_id: Ada 150 telur dinosaurus. Sebanyak 48 adalah telur karnivora dan sisanya herbivora. Jika 17 telur karnivora menetas dan telur herbivora yang menetas lima kali sebanyak itu, berapa telur herbivora yang belum menetas?
hint_steps_en: Herbivorous eggs: 150 − 48 = 102.
Hatched herbivorous eggs: 5 × 17 = 85.
Unhatched: 102 − 85 = 17, so choose A.
hint_steps_id: Telur herbivora: 150 − 48 = 102.
Telur herbivora yang menetas: 5 × 17 = 85.
Belum menetas: 102 − 85 = 17, jadi pilih A.

highlights.note_en: This is the total of both types.
highlights.note_id: Ini jumlah kedua jenis.

highlights.phrase_en: five times as many herbivorous eggs hatch

highlights.note_en: Multiply the 17 hatched carnivorous eggs by five.
highlights.note_id: Kalikan 17 telur karnivora yang menetas dengan lima.

strategy.name_en: Find the herbivorous total, then subtract hatched eggs

questions.body_en: Four identical mugs total 36. A cup multiplied by an identical cup equals 49. What is one mug plus one cup?
questions.body_id: Empat mug yang sama berjumlah 36. Sebuah cangkir dikali cangkir yang sama sama dengan 49. Berapakah satu mug ditambah satu cangkir?
hint_steps_en: One mug is 36 ÷ 4 = 9.
The cup is 7 because 7 × 7 = 49.
Mug + cup = 9 + 7 = 16, so choose B.
hint_steps_id: Satu mug bernilai 36 ÷ 4 = 9.
Cangkir bernilai 7 karena 7 × 7 = 49.
Mug + cangkir = 9 + 7 = 16, jadi pilih B.

highlights.note_en: Divide by four to get one mug.
highlights.note_id: Bagi empat untuk memperoleh satu mug.

145 is not greater than 150, so follow the false branch.
hint_steps_id: Hitung A + B = 65 + 80 = 145.
145 tidak lebih besar dari 150, jadi ikuti cabang salah.

questions.body_en: The balances are level. One A balances B + C + D, one C balances B + D, and one A balances three D balls. How many B balls balance one D ball?
questions.body_id: Semua neraca seimbang. Satu A seimbang dengan B + C + D, satu C seimbang dengan B + D, dan satu A seimbang dengan tiga bola D. Berapa bola B yang seimbang dengan satu D?
hint_steps_en: C = B + D.
A = B + C + D = 2B + 2D, while A = 3D.
So 2B + 2D = 3D, giving D = 2B. The answer is 2.
hint_steps_id: C = B + D.
A = B + C + D = 2B + 2D, sedangkan A = 3D.
Jadi 2B + 2D = 3D, sehingga D = 2B. Jawabannya 2.

questions.body_en: The same shape represents the same digit in the vertical addition. Find square + triangle + circle.
questions.body_id: Bentuk yang sama mewakili digit yang sama pada penjumlahan bersusun. Tentukan persegi + segitiga + lingkaran.
hint_steps_en: 2022 has 4 digits, so the leading 2 is a carry out of the hundreds column.
Hundreds: 3 × square = 18, plus a carry 2 makes 20, so square = 6; then the tens force triangle = 8 and the units force circle = 8.
So square + triangle + circle = 6 + 8 + 8 = 22 (666 + 668 + 688 = 2022).
hint_steps_id: 2022 punya 4 angka, jadi angka 2 di depan adalah simpanan dari kolom ratusan.
Ratusan: 3 × persegi = 18, ditambah simpanan 2 menjadi 20, jadi persegi = 6; lalu puluhan memaksa segitiga = 8 dan satuan memaksa lingkaran = 8.
Jadi persegi + segitiga + lingkaran = 6 + 8 + 8 = 22 (666 + 668 + 688 = 2022).

highlights.phrase_en: same shape represents the same digit
highlights.phrase_id: Bentuk yang sama mewakili digit yang sama
highlights.note_en: Use one digit consistently in every column.

highlights.note_en: The column carries determine their total.

questions.body_en: A matching-pairs card game uses pairs of equal ranks plus one unpaired Jack. The visible hands are shown. How many cards must Danny have?

That leaves 2, 8, K and 3 as singles — their four partners must be in Danny’s hand.
The one extra Jack added to the deck has no partner, so Danny holds it too: 4 + 1 = 5 cards.
hint_steps_id: Kartu bernilai sama berpasangan: dua kartu 9, dua kartu 5, dan dua Jack.
Tersisa 2, 8, K dan 3 sebagai tunggal — keempat pasangannya pasti ada di tangan Danny.
Satu Jack tambahan dalam dek tak punya pasangan, jadi Danny memegangnya juga: 4 + 1 = 5 kartu.

questions.body_en: There are 6 blue, 6 red, and 6 green balls. Blue balls weigh 3 kg, red balls 2 kg, and green balls 1 kg. The 18 balls are shared among Ada, Bella, and Carter so each gets 6 balls of total weight 12 kg, with three different color combinations. How many red balls does Carter get?
questions.body_id: Ada 6 bola biru, 6 merah, dan 6 hijau. Bola biru beratnya 3 kg, merah 2 kg, dan hijau 1 kg. Delapan belas bola dibagi kepada Ada, Bella, dan Carter sehingga masing-masing mendapat 6 bola dengan berat total 12 kg, dengan tiga kombinasi warna yang berbeda. Berapa bola merah yang diperoleh Carter?
hint_steps_en: For 6 balls weighing 12 kg, let blue = x and red = y. Then 2x + y = 6.
The possible combinations are (0,6,0), (1,4,1), (2,2,2), and (3,0,3).
The three different combinations that use all six of each color are (1,4,1), (2,2,2), and (3,0,3). Carter's row has 4 red balls.
hint_steps_id: Untuk 6 bola seberat 12 kg, misalkan biru = x dan merah = y. Maka 2x + y = 6.
Kombinasi yang mungkin adalah (0,6,0), (1,4,1), (2,2,2), dan (3,0,3).
Tiga kombinasi berbeda yang memakai semua enam bola tiap warna adalah (1,4,1), (2,2,2), dan (3,0,3). Baris Carter memiliki 4 bola merah.

highlights.phrase_en: each gets 6 balls of total weight 12 kg
highlights.phrase_id: masing-masing mendapat 6 bola dengan berat total 12 kg
highlights.note_en: Convert the weight condition to 2x + y = 6.
highlights.note_id: Ubah syarat berat menjadi 2x + y = 6.

highlights.note_en: Choose combinations that also use six of each color overall.
highlights.note_id: Pilih kombinasi yang juga memakai enam bola tiap warna secara total.

strategy.name_en: Enumerate equal-weight color combinations
strategy.name_id: Daftar semua kombinasi warna dengan berat sama

questions.body_en: Four soldiers numbered 1, 2, 3, and 4 march across the pictured holes. The front soldiers fill each hole, then climb out and rejoin as shown. What is the final order?
questions.body_id: Empat prajurit bernomor 1, 2, 3, dan 4 berbaris melewati lubang pada gambar. Prajurit terdepan mengisi setiap lubang, lalu memanjat keluar dan bergabung kembali seperti ditunjukkan. Apa urutan akhirnya?
hint_steps_en: Simulate the first hole exactly as the example: the front soldier moves behind the others.
Repeat the shown fill-and-climb order at the second hole.
The final left-to-right order is 4, 2, 1, 3, giving 4213.
hint_steps_id: Simulasikan lubang pertama seperti contoh: prajurit terdepan berpindah ke belakang yang lain.
Ulangi urutan masuk dan memanjat yang ditunjukkan pada lubang kedua.
Urutan akhir dari kiri ke kanan adalah 4, 2, 1, 3, sehingga 4213.

highlights.phrase_en: fill each hole, then climb out and rejoin as shown
highlights.phrase_id: mengisi setiap lubang, lalu memanjat keluar dan bergabung kembali seperti ditunjukkan
highlights.note_en: Preserve the exact movement order from the diagram.
highlights.note_id: Pertahankan urutan gerakan tepat seperti gambar.

strategy.name_en: Simulate the queue through each hole
strategy.name_id: Simulasikan antrean melewati tiap lubang

questions.body_en: The solid uses white 1×1×1 blocks, gray 1×1×2 blocks, and black 1×1×3 blocks. Use the two mirror views to determine how many white blocks are used.
questions.body_id: Bangun ruang menggunakan balok putih 1×1×1, abu-abu 1×1×2, dan hitam 1×1×3. Gunakan dua tampak cermin untuk menentukan banyak balok putih yang digunakan.
hint_steps_en: Match each visible colored run in both mirrors to its block length.
Account for the gray length-2 and black length-3 blocks first.
The remaining exposed unit positions require 3 white 1×1×1 blocks.
hint_steps_id: Cocokkan setiap rangkaian warna pada kedua cermin dengan panjang baloknya.
Hitung dahulu balok abu-abu panjang 2 dan hitam panjang 3.
Posisi satuan yang tersisa memerlukan 3 balok putih 1×1×1.

highlights.note_en: Both projections describe the same solid.
highlights.note_id: Kedua proyeksi menggambarkan bangun yang sama.

highlights.note_en: White pieces each occupy one unit.
highlights.note_id: Setiap balok putih menempati satu satuan.

strategy.name_en: Reconcile both projections by block length
strategy.name_id: Cocokkan kedua proyeksi berdasarkan panjang balok

questions.body_en: Rotate the T-shaped cover freely on the 4×4 value grid. Find the maximum sum of the four covered squares.
questions.body_id: Putar penutup berbentuk T sesuka hati pada kisi nilai 4×4. Tentukan jumlah maksimum dari empat petak yang tertutup.
hint_steps_en: Evaluate the arithmetic in every grid cell first.
Test each legal T placement in all four rotations.
The best placement covers 43, 28, 20, and 57: 43 + 28 + 20 + 57 = 148.
hint_steps_id: Hitung dahulu nilai aritmetika di setiap petak.
Uji setiap posisi T yang sah dalam empat arah.
Posisi terbaik menutup 43, 28, 20, dan 57: 43 + 28 + 20 + 57 = 148.

highlights.phrase_id: Putar penutup berbentuk T sesuka hati
highlights.note_en: Check all four orientations, not just the pictured one.
highlights.note_id: Periksa keempat orientasi, bukan hanya yang tergambar.

highlights.note_en: Compare totals for every legal placement.
highlights.note_id: Bandingkan total setiap posisi yang sah.
